title: Generalization of Toeplitz + Hankel operators in the polydisc
summary: In this paper, we obtain a complete classification of Toeplitz + Hankel operators on the vector-valued Hardy space $H^2_{\mathcal{E}}(\mathbb{D}^n)$ over the polydisc $\mathbb{D}^n$ in $\mathbb{C}^n$ for $n\geq 1$. We also characterize the paired operators on $L^2(\mathbb{T}^n)$. Furthermore, we give a complete characterization for the class of essentially Toeplitz + essentially Hankel operators on the vector-valued Hardy space $H^2_{\mathcal{E}}(\mathbb{D})$ for finite-dimensional Hilbert space $\mathcal{E}$.
